verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents its own off-ramp: a hosted and API-driven sell flow where users choose a fiat currency and a payout method and are paid to a bank account or Visa card. Sell-side requote webhooks back this up. The pack never shows a published list of supported payout currencies or countries, and nothing addresses stablecoin-specific conversion or which bank-transfer rails are used. Missing for 10: published currency/country coverage list, documented bank-transfer rails for payouts (e.g., SEPA/ACH/local rails on the sell side), stablecoin-specific off-ramp evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: Turn your crypto into cash. In a flash. Get paid straight to your bank account or Visa card.
A hosted on-ramp and off-ramp you embed in your app. MoonPay runs the KYC, payments, and UI.
Confirm the cryptocurrency, fiat, and amount to sell. 2. Log in to the widget using multi-factor authentication (MFA). 3. Select payout method.
Handle the sell_transaction_requote_required webhook to surface in-app requote notifications when a sell price changes.
